items.title: Looking for a remote job, but I don't have any college experience...
items.text:
Looking for a remote job, but I don't have any college experience...
Been looking for online work for months, but most seem to only be willing to hire those in school or graduated. I have looked into fiverr, upworks, ghost writing, and customer service.  Not much luck. I don't mind minimum wage work and I like trying new things. Definitely don't want to get involved in an MLM... does anyone here work online with just a high school diploma?
Thank you! How long did it take you to learn? Are there any resources you would suggest? I never thought of doing that!
Thank you! I am definitely going to look into it I never thought of doing  that
Although I usually come here for the typical progress pics, I am always happy to see more of the atypical ones  like this! Congrats! I hope you feel like smiling all the time now

Thank you, I prefer when people are straight forward me so I appreciate that. She nonstop harasses me every single day. Every time I ignore I feel so guilty. She will send tons of texts acting so worried about me and worried i got hurt because I don't answer. I was thinking of going on medicare and just getting my own phone plan, i know once I have income I can afford it.  How much would you suggest saving?

This is all really helpful advice. I need to learn to set a budget once and for all. I will definitely try that with the texts...i usually will just text and say "sorry I'm having a busy day" or "doing uber eats" and she usually leaves me alone after that.  I wish I could have been taught things like this as kid, your response means the world to me... I have so little support right now. Thank you.
